name: Dimapur Town
description: Largest city and commercial gateway of Nagaland, located on the Dhansiri River plains, serving as the primary entry point by air and rail for the state.
facts: Main airport and railway hub of Nagaland
Elevation around 145 m
Ancient capital of the Kachari kingdom

name: Kachari Ruins
description: Medieval ruins of the Kachari Rajbari featuring distinctive mushroom-domed sandstone pillars and carved monoliths from the 10th-13th century Dimasa Kachari kingdom.
facts: Protected by Archaeological Survey of India
Mushroom-shaped pillars believed to be fertility symbols or chess pieces
Best visited October to March

name: Green Park
description: Landscaped recreational park inside the State Horticulture Nursery at 4th Mile, featuring greenery, boating, ziplining, and picnic facilities popular with families.
facts: Located within State Horticulture Nursery
Offers boating, water zorbing and ziplining
Ideal for picnics in winter months

name: NEZCC Stone Garden and Museum
description: North East Zone Cultural Centre complex with a stone sculpture garden of 31 artworks by Indian sculptors and a heritage museum showcasing crafts from eight northeastern states.
facts: Located near Dimapur Airport and railway station
Features traditional morungs and amphitheatre
Preserves Northeast cultural artifacts

name: Niathu Resort
description: 50-acre resort near Dimapur Airport meaning 'Sunrise' in Angami, offering alpine-style chalets, anthurium gardens and family amenities by the Chate River.
facts: Five-minute drive from Dimapur Airport
Seven alpine chalet suites
Popular for short getaways

name: Noune Resort
description: Peaceful mini-tourist resort at Seithekiema A village about 10 km from Dimapur, featuring a large water body for boating and angling plus children's facilities.
facts: Name means Peace in Angami Naga
Offers water zorbing and adventure activities
Pastoral setting ideal for relaxation

name: Heirloom Naga Centre
description: Creative hub near Sovima Village uniting Naga craft brands, workshops, gallery and guest house showcasing traditional and contemporary Naga design.
facts: Approximately 15 minutes from Dimapur Airport
Features Heirloom gallery of curated Naga artifacts
Supports local artisans through retail and mentorship

name: Hong Kong Market
description: Bustling flea market in central Dimapur known for imported goods, clothing, electronics and local Naga products, a vibrant commercial landmark.
facts: One of the most popular markets in Dimapur
Mix of local handicrafts and imported items
Lively street food nearby
